License: LICENSE.txt covers libpd. The full runtime also includes component-specific licenses; see licenses/README.txt and the retained notices in licenses/.

Full runtime added for original Envion:
Artifact: demo/libpd-worklet-full.js at the same upstream commit.
Packages: Pure Data vanilla + Cyclone + ELSE.
AV modifications: asynchronous validated virtual file read/write message handlers.
Wrapper additions: binary asset pass-through and writeFile/readFile promises.
The embedded WASM is unchanged. No audio device or host filesystem access is exposed by the virtual file handlers.

Pinned third-party submodules from the upstream git tree:
Pure Data: b1ff370c87b579f80130a9cafbf27cd890e90882
Cyclone: d2cff143021c8b1a1f3cd5c71cdb32c5576ba85a
ELSE: bd3fbb5a688276dcf650de8bb6a18ec0fd6017b0
ELSE contains mixed-license components, including GPL-2.0-or-later giga.rev~ and fdn.rev~ linked by the upstream full build.
Pinned source archives, build instructions, copyright notices and the complete AV JavaScript modification patch are available in licenses/README.txt.
Full-runtime lifecycle compatibility: close retires the whole WASM instance instead of calling failing upstream GUI destructors; process returns false. Replacing an open full-runtime patch requires creating a new instance and closing its previous AudioContext.
